melee: It comes straight at me. No hesitation. That's either courage or hunger.
melee_crypt: It moves like something that's been sleeping too long and is still half-dreaming.
melee_moss: Wet footsteps. Fast. It knows this ground better than I do.
ranged: It stopped before I saw it. Already calculating angles.
ranged_gallery: It uses the columns. Every shot is deliberate. This one has been hunting longer than I have.
ranged_catacomb: The shot came from the dark. It was waiting. They all wait down here.
elite: Bigger than the rest. Slower, but that's not comfort — it means it doesn't need to be fast.
elite_crypt: The old dead are different. They remember more. That makes them worse.
swarm: One would be nothing. There are never just one.
swarm_moss: The growth carries them. They move like spores — scattered until they're not.
caster: It's reaching for something I can't see. I need to close the distance before it finishes.
caster_brick: Something learned the words down here. That shouldn't be possible.
ambush: I didn't hear it. I didn't see it. The only reason I'm still standing is that it wanted me scared first.
ambush_catacomb: The bones shifted. By the time I understood what that meant, it was already behind me.
